title: Fantasiestücke - No. 1 Des Abends
notable_excerpt: Key: Ab major. Chord journey: I - ii - V - ii7 - V ii-V loops throughout, vi and bVI colour mid-piece, closes on ii5 with a lingering half-cadence. Texture: sixteenth-note arpeggiated accompaniment under a singing melody.
video_use_ideas: Sketch material for a film-score cue: take the opening bars and re-orchestrate.
legal_notes: Composer died 1856 (PD). OCR draft: optical music recognition (Audiveris 5.11) of the public-domain scan IMSLP #29770 (Clara Schumann ed., Breitkopf & Härtel 1879), corrected against the page images by an AI model (see tools/omr REPORT). Bar count matches the scan, 0 wrong-length bars, model self-estimate rhythm ~97%, pitch ~92% (an independent spot check of a GPT-6.1 Sol piece found pitch ~85% against a claimed 98%, so treat pitch claims as optimistic). MAY CONTAIN WRONG NOTES. Slurs, pedal and most ornaments not encoded. Transcription released CC0. MusicXML: files/scores/schumann_op12_fantasiestuecke_1.musicxml. Fills complete-set gap: Schumann Fantasiestücke Op. 12. No pre-rendered preview: the site plays the score MIDI with an in-browser General MIDI synth; no third-party recording.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
